findings.title: Overflowing JSON usage number could abort final benchmark serialization
findings.reproduction: Mock an SSE completed choice with finish_reason=stop, followed by choices=[] and usage={completion_tokens:1,prompt_tokens:1e999}, then [DONE]. Before the fix, probe returned ok=true and usage.prompt_tokens=inf; json.dumps(row, allow_nan=False) raised ValueError. No network requests were made.
findings.impact: Malformed or overflowing endpoint metrics could leave the reserved report partially written after other requests completed. Ordinary finite usage and protocol completion were unaffected.
findings.recommended_fix: Reject nonfinite parsed floating-point values before retaining event fields; cover positive and negative exponent overflow.
findings.fix: finite_json_float calls math.isfinite and is passed as json.loads parse_float; rejection occurs before usage assignment.
findings.verification: Independently reran the original mocked SSE reproduction with both 1e999 and -1e999. Each records ok=false/error_type=ValueError/usage=null and serializes with allow_nan=False. The new regression test passes.
